run_distillation_training: run teacher-student distillation training for Flax Whisper models via CLI
create_data_loader: create a DataLoader from a streaming IterableDataset with configurable shuffling and prefetching
load_multiple_datasets: load and interleave multiple HuggingFace datasets with configurable sampling probabilities
create_learning_rate_schedule: create a linear warmup and linear decay or constant learning rate schedule function
map_student_teacher_layers: map student encoder and decoder layers to corresponding teacher layers for distillation loss
